scenes.subtitle: A short explainer
scenes.narration: Small everyday habits add up to real protection for you and the people around you.

scenes.label: protection in trials
scenes.narration: Protection rises to 95 % within a few weeks, according to trial data from many independent studies.

scenes.title: How it works
scenes.narration: The design combines a carrier & a harmless protein to trigger a strong immune response in the body.

scenes.title: Cases over time
scenes.narration: Cases fell from a hundred thousand to twenty thousand, i.e. by eighty percent, over two years of data.

scenes.title: Takeaways
scenes.narration: Simple habits such as hand washing, ventilation, etc. still matter a lot for everyone around you.
